description: Punti Noleggio bici is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. Elementi puntuali che rappresentano la geolocalizzazione dei punti di noleggio biciclette nel territorio del Comune di Firenze. Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are biciclette, ciclabilita, comune-firenze, eu, mobilita. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, SHP, WMS. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
